title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Check-Ins Confirmed by the Care Facility
content:
A contact that the borrower's care facility confirmed in an accepted facility letter on file for the profile's primary borrower is recorded on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile as a health-care absence check-in, on the date the letter states for it; the monitoring it belongs to remains as the product's rules on health-care absences provide. This entry governs the number such a check-in carries.

## Check-ins during monitoring

During monitoring a check-in is made every interval between contacts set for the plan, counted in calendar days from the absence start date, and annual notices are suspended; a check-in recording a contact confirmed by an accepted facility letter is numbered under this rule, a check-in the borrower confirms in person while still in care and the closing contact in which the borrower confirms having come home are numbered under their own rules, and every other check-in is numbered by the count of check-ins of the current absence plus one.

## Condition on the profile

> A facility-confirmed contact is numbered only after the profile carries the start date of the health-care absence under monitoring.

Equivalently: while the profile shows no start date for a health-care absence under monitoring, a facility-confirmed contact is not given its number.

## Effect

One check-in entry is added to the profile's occupancy history for the contact the cited facility letter confirms, carrying the contact date and the check-in number given and citing the letter. The entry is copied with the profile's primary borrower and loan program. Nothing else on the profile changes.

## Invocation

`record_facility_checkin_6c7d3fa5` is an agent-side tool: the servicing agent unlocks it and calls it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `residency_profile_id` | reference number of the occupancy certification profile, as returned by the occupancy profile lookup for the borrower | identifier |
| `residency_submission_id` | reference number of the accepted facility letter on file that confirms the contact, as returned by the occupancy submission lookup | identifier |
| `effective_date` | the date of the contact as the facility letter states it | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD; never empty |
| `checkin_sequence` | the check-in number the contact is recorded under on the profile | integer, 1-based, written without decimals |

## Receipt

The tool returns one line of the form "Check-in <entry reference> recorded on profile <profile reference>: number <check-in number>, dated <contact date>, letter <letter reference>." The entry reference is the new history entry's reference number; its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the check-in entry now exists and the occupancy history lookup shows it.
